oss.comment: Managed service. The Python SDK (veep) and the LangChain integration are open source under MIT.

dev_languages.comment: Vendor-submitted: the managed service's core is written in Rust.

metadata_filter.comment: Metadata filters on query; filter fields defined per collection schema.

embeddings_text.comment: By design: embedding always happens client-side. The service stores and searches vectors plus metadata; raw customer text and media never reach it.

pricing.value: Storage-only: $5.99 (hot) / $1.49 (warm) / $0.09 (paused) per GB-month; queries included; $5/month usage credits to start
pricing.comment: No per-query or egress fees; unlimited export.

disk_index.comment: Warm tier serves from local SSD via memory-mapped files and the OS page cache; paused tier archives to dense storage and rehydrates on demand.

index_types.value: Automatic: the optimizer sweeps nine index strategies per collection — HNSW, Vamana (DiskANN-family), IVF-Flat, IVF-PQ, PCA projection, LSH, and scalar/product/optimized-product quantization — scored against an exact brute-force baseline, and promotes the best performer for the collection's data and recall target; no manual tuning
index_types.comment: There are no user-facing index knobs: every candidate is built and measured against the collection's own data, and the recall/latency evidence for each experiment is visible per collection via the SDK and MCP.

vector_dims.comment: 768d validated in the published VectorDBBench run; no public hard cap documented.
